jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Berlin
jobs.description: About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it. The mandate We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform. This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. Operating Principles: Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet. We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team. That means more than using the tools. We expect you to: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster. jobs.title: Product Design
jobs.description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . About the role We’re looking for our first product designer to level-up design throughout the company. Axle is building cutting-edge energy products across the sector - from simple offerings for mass-market consumers, through to advanced tooling for early adopters and enthusiasts. We’re innovating to solve new and complex problems where there’s no established answers and where the customer experience is key. We have a highly autonomous, flat structure, delivering our products in small interdisciplinary teams of engineers and PMs. We want to add a design voice as a pillar to this: understanding our users, leading our strategic direction, and ensuring the customer is always represented. You’ll operate across the business to raise the quality of all our design output - through both direct delivery, as well as enablement and coaching of others. Alongside this, we’re looking for ownership and support on how Axle represents itself externally - to our prospects, clients, investors and potential employees. What you will be doing: Understanding user problems and designing great experiences to solve them Building the systems that allow for strategic and scalable solutions - in Claude and code - to allow everybody to ship beautiful software, faster Deepening our culture of user research and getting into the weeds of how people experience Axle's products, both B2C and B2B

jobs.title: Live Ops Game Designer
jobs.description: HyperHug is an international game development studio specializing in the shooter genre. Our main office is based in Cyprus, but our talented team works remotely from around the world. We’re developing Oxide: Survival Island , an immersive multiplayer survival shooter for mobile platforms, and we’re always looking for motivated individuals who want to grow with us, contribute their creativity, and help shape the future of our games. We are seeking a Live Ops Game Designer to drive live content in our flagship game, Oxide: Survival Island . You will own the content that keeps players engaged and coming back: from coming up with themes for gacha, battle passes, and offers to briefing the art teams, polishing every detail, and launching it live. If you love setting things up, iterating, and making each event and store drop feel just right — this role is for you. What You’ll Be Doing: Design and manage LiveOps features — including events, passes, and offers — from initial concept and scheduling through launch. Generate themes and concepts for gacha, battle passes, and offers. Collaborate with 2D/3D art teams: define requirements, brief leads, and manage asset pipelines for in-game features and content. Keep the web shops filled with fresh content and an up-to-date assortment. Configure and implement game content in Unity. Run A/B tests, analyze the performance of events, passes, and offers, and use the findings to improve future iterations. What We Expect From You: 3+ years of experience in Game Design with a focus on mid-core/hardcore mobile games. Experience running the full LiveOps loop: events, offers, testing, scheduling, performance analysis. Strong hands-on experience with Unity. Proven work in cross-functional teams: dev, art, analytics, marketing. Extensive player experience and strong interest in the shooter genre. English - B1+ level, Russian - C1 level. jobs.title: Principal/Senior VFX Artist
jobs.description: HyperHug is an international game development studio specializing in the shooter genre. Our main office is based in Cyprus, but our talented team works remotely from around the world. We’re developing Oxide: Survival Island , an immersive multiplayer survival shooter for mobile platforms, and we’re always looking for motivated individuals who want to grow with us, contribute their creativity, and help shape the future of our games. We’re looking for a Senior VFX Artist to create high-quality, realistic visual effects for weapon skins and other game content. You’ll own the full VFX pipeline — from developing an effect concept to preparing it for integration. What You'll Be Doing: Create mobile-optimized VFX, including effects for weapon skins. Develop effect concepts based on the provided theme, models, animations, and initial ideas. Own the full VFX pipeline, from defining the scope to preparing the final effect for integration. Create shaders, create and improve other gameplay and environmental effects across the project. Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us: We provide all the software, plugins, AI tools, and asset libraries you need for your work. High autonomy: we trust your expertise and don't micromanage Space for bold ideas: create striking VFX that go far beyond standard muzzle flashes and hit impacts. What We Expect From You: 3+ years of professional experience as a VFX Artist in GameDev. A strong portfolio featuring VFX from realistic game projects. Extensive experience in Unity. Solid understanding of mobile optimization. Bonus If You Have: Experience creating VFX for cosmetic content (e.g. weapon skins). What We Offer: Competitive salary. Remote work format. A passionate and supportive team that values creativity and ownership. Opportunities for professional growth. A culture built on initiative, transparency, and collaboration.

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.description: Introduction: A UX/UI Designer is a professional who combines expertise in user experience and user interface design. This role requires a deep understanding of design principles, user behavior, and the ability to create visually appealing and highly functional interfaces that meet both user needs and business objectives. You synchronize directly with leading positions based on the teams you are part of. You report to Department Manager, Product Design Responsibilities Execute UX/UI strategy and vision for projects or product areas Taking responsibility for end-to-end user experience and interface design process within an assigned design project or product area Conduct user research, usability testing, and data analysis in collaboration with and according to Product Design Strategy Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs Contributes to the maintenance of the design systems and style guides Mentor junior designers and contribute to the team’s growth Present design solutions to stakeholders and defend design decisions based on Product Design Strategy Ownership Be accountable for the quality and consistency of design deliverables Take charge of the UX/UI roadmap within assigned projects or product areas Implement and maintain UX/UI best practices and standards according to industry standards Responsible for ensuring that design outcomes meet relevant accessibility guidelines Take responsibility for personal growth, goal setting, and skill development Impact Drive improvements in key UX/UI metrics and KPIs for the projects or product area Contribute to design processes that lead to positive user experience, engagement, and retention Influence product strategy based on research insights and innovative design solutions Enhance the overall quality and consistency of the user experience and design solutions Foster a human-centered design culture within the organization Talent Continuously improve personal design skills and stay updated with industry

jobs.description: About AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it.
